تسببت الأمطار الغزيرة في خطر افتراضي لحدوث سيول مفاجئة في منطقة الوادي. ابتعدوا عن مياه السيول والمناطق المنخفضة، وانتقلوا إلى أماكن مرتفعة إذا كان ذلك آمناً. اتبعوا تعليمات جهة الطوارئ الافتراضية.

simulation_policy.cap_reference: SRC-01; advisory knowledge only, not a CAP document or conformance decision
simulation_policy.effective_warning_coverage_gate: Actually selected arrival <=30 s AND content sufficient AND documented individual format usability; unknown is not success. Delayed 30<t<=60 contributes only technical reach.

content_requirements.test_rule: A channel can be considered actionable only if its documented rendered content conveys sufficient protective instructions and the individual can use that format; timely arrival alone is insufficient.
content_requirements.public_sirens_rule: Alert-only; cannot independently establish Effective Warning Coverage
content_requirements.evaluation_independence: Content sufficiency is distinct from technical delivery and individual accessibility/usability.
content_requirements.decision_rule: Sufficient only when all three fields positively evidenced in the actual modeled rendering as received; Insufficient if any required element is confirmed missing; Needs Further Review if rendering, segment completeness or evidence is unknown. Sirens are alert-only and insufficient for standalone actionable coverage.

channel_rendering_handoff.status: Approved Arabic per-channel renderings are in approved_channel_renderings; technical rendering evidence, TTS audio, mapping to schemas and integration tests remain outstanding.
channel_rendering_handoff.rule: All renderings are fixed for all stages and tested plans; no AI rewriting, simplification, auto-translation or resident-specific content generation.

open_checks: Create and document Arabic TTS audio file MP3/WAV and measure playback duration separately from simulated call arrival.
Verify physical SMS segmentation/receipt handling in simulation; no assumption that multipart SMS is fully received.
Align fixture IDs and content evidence with Salma schemas.py and agent_contracts.md; do not change her contracts without agreement.
Test complete renderings, per-resident usability and content sufficiency after integration; no invented coverage measurements.
Do not claim CAP validation, compliance certification or real operational warning.
